author: Ankit
problem: Read N stands and M flavors as N strings of 'o' and 'x' (the j-th character of string i is 'o' if stand i sells flavor j). Print the minimum number of stands to visit to get every flavor.
bug_description: `exist[j] == True` compares instead of assigning, so no flavor is ever marked and the answer is always N.

comments.accurate: Tries every subset of stands and keeps the smallest one that covers all flavors
comments.wrong_behavior: Visits every stand, since any of them may be the only seller of some flavor
comments.wrong_location: Flavor marking verified; check the bit test that picks which stands are in the subset
